connect.subtitle: Pair via serial interface or BLE

tuning.title: Firmware Parameters
tuning.subtitle: Adjust controller logic and motor limits
tuning.speedDesc: Configurable up to 127 km/h (free-spinning / wheel elevated in the air only). Under real road load and your rider weight, effective speed will be significantly lower and deviate heavily.
tuning.realDesc: 127 km/h only reachable with wheel elevated in the air. On asphalt, road speed deviates significantly due to rider weight, tire friction, and battery voltage sag.
tuning.modesDesc: Governor limit per active dashboard profile (real road speed deviates heavily)
tuning.panicDesc: Configure a stealth physical combination (2 to 12 inputs). Triggering forces stock 20 km/h mode and requires the 6-digit recovery PIN to restore.
tuning.phaseCurrentDesc: Peak amperage delivered to stator coils (higher = torque, heat)
tuning.regenCurrentDesc: Negative phase current applied during deceleration

premium.title: Performance Suite
premium.subtitle: Experimental algorithm extensions
premium.wheelieDesc: Reads internal 6-axis IMU pitch data and modulates PWM motor duty cycle to hold front-wheel lift without loop-out risk.
premium.fieldWeakeningDesc: Injects negative d-axis stator current at top RPM to reduce counter-EMF, allowing +12-18 km/h over rated motor speed at cost of heat.
premium.tempThrottleDesc: Automatically ramps down phase amps if MOSFET junction temperature crosses 78°C to protect motor windings.
premium.comingSoonDesc: CAN-Bus packet sniffer, traction slip control (TC), and custom battery SOC voltage curves are currently undergoing bench testing.

settings.firmwareLockDesc: Germany 20 km/h and EU 25 km/h restrictions are patched at runtime.
